title: Mock Board fact-card file
description: One file per topic (data/cards/<topic>.json). Mirrors the FactCard Pydantic model in src/mockboard/brain/schemas.py; src/mockboard/brain/cards.py validates every topic file against this schema and then against FactCard. If FactCard changes, update this file to match.

topic.description: Must equal the file name without .json, e.g. tourism.

description.description: Optional note about this card set (who authored it, from which sources, when).

id.description: Unique across all topics. Lower-case letters, digits, underscore, hyphen.

topic.description: Optional; the loader fills it from the file's topic.

statement.description: One checkable fact in one sentence, with number, unit and year.

aliases.description: Other ways a candidate might phrase the same thing (English or Hinglish).

unit.description: e.g. percent, percentage_points, crore inr, lakh visitors, year.

as_of.description: Date the owner checked the source, YYYY-MM-DD.
